newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher, uptrend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher, uptrend seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished higher on Monday on tightening liquidity due to the central bank's recent NCDs issues and payments of T$30 billion of government bonds on Tuesday, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.982 percent against Saturday's 4.707, with 30-day commercial paper up to 4.85-4.90 against 4.75. Dealers expected the money rates to rise to above the 5.00 percent level on Tuesday.
The bond market was quiet amid bearish sentiment. The seven-year 83/2 government bond yield was at 5.4125 percent.
